items.name: LogDataHandler
items.summary: Provides semanitc access to the log data.

methods.name: iter
methods.summary: Iterate over each file as a [`LogicalFileView`] without materializing all of them at once.

methods.name: max_values
methods.summary: return the maximum values for the named column, if known. Note: the returned array must contain `num_containers()` rows.

methods.name: min_values
methods.summary: return the minimum values for the named column, if known. Note: the returned array must contain `num_containers()` rows

methods.name: null_counts
methods.summary: return the number of null values for the named column as an `Option<UInt64Array>`.

methods.name: num_containers
methods.summary: return the number of containers (e.g. row groups) being pruned with these statistics

methods.name: num_files
methods.summary: The number of files in the log data. Returns the total number of files represented across all underlying record batches.

methods.name: parse_predicate_expression
methods.signature: fn parse_predicate_expression(&self, expr: impl AsRef<str>, session: &dyn Session) -> DeltaResult<Expr>

methods.name: row_counts
methods.summary: return the number of rows in each container as an `Option<UInt64Array>`.
